wins.text: Record Q2 revenue of $7.7B, up 32% YoY, exceeding guidance midpoint despite $800M MI308 export control headwind
Client & Gaming segment revenue surged 69% YoY to $3.6B, with record Client CPU sales of $2.5B (up 67% YoY) and Gaming up 73% YoY to $1.1B
EPYC delivered 33rd consecutive quarter of YoY server CPU share gains; record cloud and enterprise CPU sales with Turin ramping significantly
Record free cash flow of $1.2B in Q2; $1.2B in share repurchases in H1 2025 with $9.5B remaining under buyback authorization

MI350 series entered volume production ahead of schedule in June; Oracle building 27,000+ node cluster with MI355X, Turin CPUs and Pollara 400 NICs; HUMAIN multibillion-dollar sovereign AI collaboration announced

risks.text: U.S. export controls eliminated MI308 sales to China, triggering an $800M inventory write-down and reducing Q2 GAAP gross margin by ~10 points to 43%; no MI308 revenue included in Q3 guidance
Data Center segment swung to an operating loss of $155M in Q2 vs. $743M operating income a year ago, entirely due to the export control inventory charges
MI308 China inventory is mostly WIP, requiring several quarters to ramp once licenses are approved, creating uncertainty around timing and magnitude of revenue recovery
Embedded segment revenue declined 4% YoY to $824M with mixed end-market demand and pockets of industrial customer inventory reduction actions
Gaming segment (console semi-custom) expected to decline strongly double-digits in Q4 2025 as customers complete holiday season inventory builds, pressuring Client & Gaming segment sequentially

guidance_items.detail: Q3 2025 revenue guided to ~$8.7B ±$300M, representing ~28% YoY growth and ~13% sequential growth; well above Q2 record of $7.7B
Q3 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~54%, roughly flat with Q2 ex-charges, reflecting MI350 ramp offset by operational efficiency gains
Data Center segment expected strong double-digit sequential growth in Q3 driven by MI350 series ramp; Instinct GPU revenue expected to grow YoY in Q3
Client & Gaming segment expected modest sequential growth in Q3; Client up, Gaming flattish; Embedded returns to sequential growth
Q3 non-GAAP opex ~$2.55B; non-GAAP tax rate 13%; net interest/other ~$10M gain; diluted share count ~1.63B

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Specific sizing and timeline for MI308 China revenue recovery once licenses are approved, including inventory ramp mechanics
Gross margin trajectory for MI GPU products and the revenue scale required for them to become accretive to corporate margins
Specific quantitative milestones or time frame for reaching 'tens of billions' in AI GPU revenue (e.g., 2027 feasibility)
